select u.sub_domain               as slug,
       u.id                       as quelle_user_id,
       u.email                    as email,
       u.first_name               as first_name,
       u.last_name                as last_name,
       u.full_name                as full_name,
       u.country                  as country,
       u.preferred_newsletter_language as preferred_language,
       o.name                     as organisation_name,
       u.herbalife_id             as herbalife_id
  from prod_activesupport.users u
  left join prod_activesupport.organizations o on o.id = u.organization_id
 where u.deleted_at is null
   and u.sub_domain is not null and u.sub_domain <> ''

with quelle as (
  select * from jsonb_to_recordset(($1::jsonb)) as x(
    slug text, quelle_user_id bigint, email text, first_name text, last_name text,
    full_name text, country text, preferred_language text, organisation_name text, herbalife_id text)
), eingefuegt as (
  insert into leads.berater (slug, quelle_user_id, email, first_name, last_name, full_name,
                             country, preferred_language, organisation_name, herbalife_id, gespiegelt_am)
  select slug, quelle_user_id, email, first_name, last_name, full_name,
         country, preferred_language, organisation_name, herbalife_id, now()
    from quelle
  on conflict (slug) do update set
    quelle_user_id = excluded.quelle_user_id, email = excluded.email,
    first_name = excluded.first_name, last_name = excluded.last_name,
    full_name = excluded.full_name, country = excluded.country,
    preferred_language = excluded.preferred_language,
    organisation_name = excluded.organisation_name, herbalife_id = excluded.herbalife_id,
    gespiegelt_am = now()
  returning slug
), entfernt as (
  delete from leads.berater b
   where not exists (select 1 from quelle q where q.slug = b.slug)
  returning b.slug
)
select (select count(*) from eingefuegt) as geschrieben,
       (select count(*) from entfernt)   as entfernt,
       (select count(*) from leads.berater) as im_verzeichnis
